provenance.note: Native epoch-2 installation with completed history, a separate awaiting-human draft, small content artifacts and explicitly imported history. Authored from declarations and RFC, not converter output. Native journals use the released AtomicApply envelopes; skill snapshot hashes use the path-and-bytes tree digest; the lock records post-commit deletion of an absent skill. RFC-056 frozen definitions use the released clarify-cross-agent kind and workflow schema 4; the node ID remains cross-clarify. The seeded active administrator has completed RFC-221 bootstrap. Workgroup mention display names follow the released no-whitespace grammar. The review source declares its document output as markdown using the released frontmatter_extra.outputKinds sidecar. The retained disabled-plugin/MCP/skill associations belong to upgrade-helper; the executable review writer has no disabled dependencies. All association tables retain their rows. The historical helper depends on the writer, not vice versa, so disabled historical integrations are outside the executable workflow closure.
